description: Solve the mate graph and get part poses. Pass code/file for an atomic source-bound solve, or omit both to use the active assembly. Returns { ok, status, poses, iterations?, evaluationEvidence? } where each pose is a serialized Transform ({ translation, rotateAxis, rotateDeg }). Optional poses overrides mate pose values by mate name. Supplied source is captured once, consumed within this call and released after solving.

code.description: Inline kernelCAD source to capture and solve in this call.

file.description: Path to a kernelCAD script to capture and solve in this call. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

poses.description: Optional numeric pose overrides keyed by mate name.

name: solve_mates
title: Solve Mates
